summary: Verified deployment asset-packaging fix for LastZHood local-runtime (Pyodide) assets at preview URL. Landing page loads with LASTZHOOD title and START GAME button. Clicking START GAME successfully boots the in-browser local game engine: all 17 /local-runtime/* assets (pyodide.js, pyodide.asm.js, pyodide.asm.wasm, python_stdlib.zip, game.zip, pyodide-lock.json, manifest.json, and 10 .whl wheels) return HTTP 200. Pyodide loaded all python packages (annotated-types, cffi, micropip, pycparser, pydantic, pydantic_core, typing-extensions, typing-inspection) and the game UI (character loadout screen with 6 characters, soldier 3D model canvas) rendered. No 'Missing browser game asset' errors, no local-runtime 404s.

issues: Non-blocking: Reown/WalletConnect AppKit fails to fetch remote project config (HTTP 400/403) because projectId is placeholder 'REPLACE_WITH_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID'. Wallet connect falls back to local defaults. Does not affect local game start, but should be set via real WalletConnect projectId before shipping wallet features.

critical_code_review_comments: WalletConnect projectId is a placeholder in production bundle ('REPLACE_WITH_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID'); set real projectId via env var before enabling wallet flows.
WalletConnect Core init warning: 'Init() was called 2 times' — likely double initialization in React Strict Mode or a duplicate provider mount; worth consolidating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 local-runtime assets confirmed served at HTTP 200 from preview URL. Pyodide engine boots correctly; test clicked START GAME, saw canvases render and loadout UI. If regression occurs, check scripts/package_local_engine.py --runtime output and frontend/public/local-runtime/ contents, plus .gitignore un-ignore rule for local-runtime/.
